luci-theme-design-x.description: Read-only system metrics for the design-x LuCI theme dashboard. All methods are pure reads of /sys/class/, /proc/, or via iwinfo/nlbw ubus calls — no writes, no exec of user input. Replaces the legacy unauthenticated /cgi-bin/design/* endpoints (Round 42 Step 163, Codex P1-6).
